moves.name: Potion
moves.description: Restores an ally’s HP by approximately 40% of its maximum HP.

moves.name: Mega Healing!
moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1. If the user’s Venusaur has Mega Evolved, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 2. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the sync move countdown of all allied players instead. Applies the Gradual Healing effect to all allied sync pairs.

moves.name: Tenacious Frenzy Plant
moves.description: Become Mega Venusaur until the end of battle. This attack’s power increases when the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

passives.name: A Journey in Green Awaits
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs when attacking a target that is poisoned or badly poisoned. The user’s moves never miss. Lowers the target’s Grass Type Rebuff by 1 rank the first time the user’s attack move is successful each battle.

subPassives.name: Opp Poisoned: Team Moves ↑ 2
subPassives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs when attacking a target that is poisoned or badly poisoned.

subPassives.name: 1st Hit: Grass Rebuff ↓
subPassives.description: Lowers the target’s Grass Type Rebuff by 1 rank the first time the user’s attack move is successful each battle.

passives.name: Venomous 4
passives.description: Has a chance (50%) of leaving the target badly poisoned when the user’s move targeting that opponent is successful.

passives.name: Sundering 9
passives.description: Has a chance (100%) of lowering the target’s Defense or Sp. Def—or both—by one stat rank when the user’s move targeting that opponent is successful.

passives.name: Adrenaline 2
passives.description: Reduces the sync move countdown by 2 the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle.
